CONTEXT & PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

The Total Rewards team is entering a high-intensity period: a year-end compensation review cycle, active benchmarking work, custom bonus plan reviews, and a rising volume of analytical deliverables supporting executive and board-level reporting. To protect bandwidth and quality, we are bringing in a mid-level contractor to work closely with and under the supervision of our Paris-based Compensation & Benefits Expert, reporting directly to the Head of Total Rewards. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role for someone with genuine C&B grounding who can work with light direction once context is set, and who understands what makes compensation data credible.




WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING ON



Year-End Compensation Review

 - Support data preparation and validation for the annual merit, performance, and bonus review cycles: building and maintaining population files, tracking timelines, and flagging data quality issues before they become problems.

 - Work closely with the C&B Expert on modelling and scenario analysis (budget impact, distribution curves, outlier identification), producing clean, auditable outputs.

 - Contribute to salary budget modelling and refresh of salary structures using latest market data, including updates to merit matrices.

 - Coordinate with HRBPs and People Ops on data collection and sign-off workflows to keep the cycle on track.
   
   

Analytical Work for Board & Executive Reporting

 - On direction from the Head of Total Rewards, carry out the underlying data pulls, analysis, and cross-checks to populate compensation metrics and summaries used in board and executive slides.

 - Produce clean, presentation-ready tables and data panels with accurate footnotes and sourcing, so outputs can be directly incorporated into slide decks.
   
   

Bonus Plan Design Reviews

 - This contractor may provide support to the C&B Expert and Head of Total Rewards during bonus plan reviews, including
   
   - Preparing and updating slide decks to support design discussions.
   
   - Running employee data analyses and refreshing payout range modelling for plan redesigns.
   
   - Using AI tools to update bonus plan rules documentation in Word as designs evolve, ensuring plan write-ups accurately reflect agreed changes ahead of final review.



Ad Hoc C&B Support

 - Support the C&B Expert on operational tasks: Workday data uploads, equity grant list preparation and validation, and patent premium tracking.

 - Support the C&B Expert and Head of Total Rewards on ad hoc projects. Examples may include aspects of job architecture and related market benchmarking analytics, pay equity & equity grant modelling.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Requirement

Experience

4 years+ in Compensation & Benefits or Total Rewards. C&B-specific experience is required; broader HR analytics backgrounds without meaningful C&B exposure will not be considered.

Education

Degree in a quantitative discipline preferred (e.g. Finance, Economics, Statistics, or equivalent).

Excel & Modelling

Advanced Excel is non-negotiable: pivot tables, scenario modelling, audit-proof workbooks, and confident handling of large datasets.

Benchmarking Tools

Hands-on experience with Radford or Mercer Comptryx strongly preferred. Familiarity with the mechanics of job matching and market data interpretation is expected.

Workday

Experience using Workday for compensation cycle management is a strong plus.

Stakeholder Exposure

Experience working with or supporting stakeholders outside France — whether across European markets or globally — is a plus.

Autonomy

Able to work from a defined brief with minimal hand-holding. Asks the right clarifying questions early; doesn't need ongoing supervision once context is clear.

Languages

Fluent English required (working language of the team). French strongly preferred — most day-to-day collaborators are Paris-based.

Tools

Comfort with AI tools (e.g. Claude, Gemini) for document drafting and workflow efficiency is welcome.




WHAT THIS ROLE IS (AND ISN'T)

This is not a strategy or design role — Ledger already has senior expertise in-house for that. What we need is someone who executes cleanly and independently at the analytical and operational level, and who brings enough C&B literacy to produce outputs that don't need to be re-done. You will be working on real, high-stakes deliverables from day one.

With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

 

The team

To sustain the company's growth, Ledger is looking for a Senior Scala Backend Engineer to join the Cloud Wallet team. This team builds and operates the backend services that power blockchain account management, transaction processing and on-chain data aggregation across all Ledger wallet surfaces, from Ledger Live to Ledger Enterprise, the custody platform used by financial institutions. Every client transaction goes through these services, and so does every new blockchain Ledger supports. We believe in the power of functional programming to build robust and scalable platforms. We take time to share, challenge, and grow together through bi-weekly knowledge-sharing sessions, meetups, conferences, and open source contributions.

 

What you’ll be doing

 - Design, build and operate the Scala services that connect Ledger wallets and the Ledger Enterprise platform to blockchain backends: account creation, operation history, transaction crafting, broadcast and lifecycle tracking.

 - Lead new blockchain integrations end to end, from the integration design (ADR) to production, across account-based, UTXO and privacy-preserving chains.

 - Own production quality on your scope: SLIs and SLOs, observability, distributed tracing. Take part in the firefighting rotation and drive incidents to resolution, including those raised by institutional clients.

 - Define clear contracts with the Coin Integration and Ledger Enterprise teams, for example where UTXO selection lives or how transaction states are exposed to consumers.

 - Write and review ADRs, challenge designs, and raise the bar on code quality, testing (including end-to-end on testnets) and technical debt management.

 - Work in an AI-native way: use coding agents daily, write the specifications, constraints and verification that let them deliver safely, and contribute to the team's AI tooling.

 - Mentor other engineers and share your knowledge across the Backend Blockchain community.
   
    

You will collaborate cross-functionally with:

 - The Coin Integration team for coin modules and new blockchain integrations.

 - The Ledger Enterprise team, main consumer of the team's services for institutional custody.

 - The Ledger Wallet, Ledger Button and Wallet XP teams as consumers of the team's backend APIs.

 - The Blockchain platform team for data model alignment, indexing and event streaming.

 - The Infrastructure and SRE teams for deployment, reliability and scalability.

 - The Security team (Donjon) for vulnerability analysis and remediation.

 - The Product team for roadmap prioritization and customer-driven requirements.

 

What we’re looking for

 - 5+ years of backend engineering, with real production ownership of distributed systems.

 - Strong production experience

 - Interest for Scala and functional programming practice

 - Hands-on blockchain integration experience: transaction lifecycle, fees, finality, reorgs, on at least two models among account-based, UTXO and privacy-preserving chains.

 - Experience with event-driven systems and data infrastructure (PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, NATS or equivalent) and with observability tooling (Datadog or equivalent).

 - Able to diagnose an incident across several services and own the outcome, from root cause to fix in production.

 - Comfortable reading and contributing to TypeScript code, as the team works on a polyglot stack.

 - Daily use of AI coding tools, with a critical eye on their output.

 - Clear written communication in English, especially for design documents and incident reports.
